title: Products — Supreme Art
description: Pharmaceutical folding cartons for every dosage form — tablet, syrup, blister, ointment, vial and sachet cartons, plus leaflets and inserts.

range.heading: Folding cartons for every dosage form.
range.lead: From tablets to syrups, we produce the full range of pharmaceutical secondary packaging — printed, die-cut, folded and glued to your specification.

items.title: Tablet & capsule cartons
items.text: For blister and strip packs, with tamper-evident closures.

items.title: Syrup & liquid cartons
items.text: Bottle cartons with partitions and inserts to protect the fill.

items.title: Blister cartons
items.text: Sized precisely to your blister format for a secure fit.

items.title: Ointment & tube cartons
items.text: Slim cartons for creams, gels and tubes.

items.title: Vial & ampoule packs
items.text: Precision cartons with die-cut fitments to hold vials in place.

items.title: Leaflets & inserts
items.text: Folded package inserts and outer sleeves to complete the pack.

cta.heading: Need a specific carton?
cta.text: Send us your artwork or dieline and we'll come back with a quote and a timeline.
